title: Copyright Office Fees
issuer: Library of Congress; Copyright Office, Library of Congress
summary: The Copyright Office is publishing a final rule establishing adjusted fees for registration, recordation, record retrieval, search and certification, the Licensing Section services, and other services. The Office last adjusted fees in 2020, based on a study of our fiscal 2016 and 2017 costs. Since that time, the costs of providing Office services have risen substantially due to inflation and other increases. The adjusted fees are intended to enable recovery of a percentage of the Office's costs, closer to historical levels, without imposing undue barriers to access its services. This rule will take effect January 5, 2027.

title: Safety Standard for Button Cell or Coin Batteries and Consumer Products Containing Such Batteries
summary: In September 2023, the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC or Commission) issued a safety standard for button cell or coin batteries and consumer products containing such products in accordance with Reese's Law. Consistent with Reese's Law, this direct final rule updates the mandatory safety standard to incorporate by reference ANSI/UL 4200A-2026.

title: Reserve Requirements of Depository Institutions
summary: The Board is amending Regulation D, Reserve Requirements of Depository Institutions, to reflect the annual indexing of the reserve requirement exemption amount and the low reserve tranche for 2027. The annual indexation of these amounts is required notwithstanding the Board's action in March 2020 of setting all reserve requirement ratios to zero. The reserve requirement exemption amount for 2027 will remain $39.2 million, unchanged from 2026, consistent with the Federal Reserve Act (the "Act"). The Board is amending Regulation D to set the amount of the low reserve tranche at $688.5 million (increased from $674.1 million in 2026). The adjustment to the low reserve tranche is derived using a statutory formula specified in the Act. The annual indexation of the reserve requirement exemption amount and low reserve tranche is required by statute but will not affect depository institutions' reserve requirements, which will remain zero.

title: Pacific Island Fisheries; Longline Retention Prohibition; Striped Marlin in the Western and Central Pacific Ocean North of the Equator
issuer: Commerce Department; National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration
summary: NMFS is prohibiting retention of Western and Central North Pacific Ocean (WCNPO) striped marlin (Kajikia audax) by vessels registered for use under a Hawaii longline limited access permit for the remainder of 2026 because the longline fishery has reached the 2026 longline retention limit. WCNPO stiped marlin are those caught in the Pacific Ocean north of the Equator (0[deg] latitude) and west of 150[deg] W longitude. This prohibition is intended to prevent the U.S. catch limit for WCNPO striped marlin from being exceeded and ensure compliance with NMFS regulations that implement decisions of the Western and Central Pacific Fisheries Commission (WCPFC).
